answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the lotus until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the voyage of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
